newsitem.title: POLAND: Underwriters take most new Bytom shares.
newsitem.headline: Underwriters take most new Bytom shares.

text.p: Undertakers took up 145,838 shares of Polish garment maker ZO Bytom SA's 250,000-share new offering, the company said in a statement on Monday.
It said that during the October 2-16 subscription all 392 subscribers who placed bids were allotted shares, priced at 27 zlotys.

State-owned Bank Handlowy SA underwrote the entire 250,000 share offering at a 13-percent discount and with a stand-by fee of five percent. The shares were offered in a large investor 150,000-share tranche and a 100,000-share retail tranche.
